name: Momota Kaito
source:
"Space, ya know, is an ally to people who want to overcome their limits without closing up."

A trainee astronaut. Because becoming an astronaut requires a college degree, he hasn’t even passed the test. Faking his way through his astronaut exams using forged documents, he became the first teen to pass the test but was also found out. Despite this, he was hired on as a trainee for being an interesting, amusing person of talent.

He hasn’t been to space yet, but he harbors a great longing to go. More than anything, he’s an energetic person who believes in dreams and romance, saying such passionate things as “you have no limits if you don’t set them yourself” and “if you don’t take risks, your dreams will stay dreams.”

[Edited from [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/154469818636/ndrv3-famitsu-info-for-december-15th-2016]jinjojess' translation[/url]]
